parameters.content:
# 1. WEBHOOK VERIFICATION
Handles Meta's GET request to verify this
webhook endpoint (hub.challenge check).
Runs once when webhook is first configured.

# 2. INCOMING MESSAGE HANDLER
Receives every WhatsApp message (POST).
Extracts sender/media/text, loads the user's
session from Postgres, and runs the
conversation logic (State Machine) to decide
the next step and reply.

# 3. AI CAPTION GENERATION
Only runs when user asks AI to write the
caption. Downloads the media, converts to
Base64, sends it to Gemini with a prompt,
and formats the returned caption for
confirmation.

# 4. SESSION SAVE & USER REPLY
Saves the updated conversation state to
Postgres, then sends the correct reply
message back to the user on WhatsApp.

# 5. POST PREPARATION
Triggered only after user confirms "Yes,
post it". Fetches the final media from
WhatsApp, uploads it to Cloudinary, and
decides which platform(s)/media type
branch to follow next.

# 6. FACEBOOK & INSTAGRAM POSTING
Actual publishing logic. Posts image/video
to Facebook and/or Instagram depending on
user's platform choice. Instagram video
posting includes a poll-and-wait loop since
IG requires the video container to finish
processing before publishing.

# 7. LOGGING
Records every completed post (success or
failure details) as a new row in the
Google Sheet for audit/tracking purposes.
